notes.title: 🚀 Ignition Arena Open Beta is NOW LIVE! 🚀
notes.content:
The Open Beta for Ignition Arena is officially live and will be running from now until Sunday at midnight (MST)! 🎮

To celebrate the launch, we’re live streaming for the next 2 hours on both YouTube and Twitch—come join us!
👉 [url=https://youtube.com/live/9Bvez_YfGRg?feature=share]YouTube[/url]
👉 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ignitionarena]Twitch[/url]

📝 Feedback Forms: A Feedback form and Bug Report form are available, and we’d greatly appreciate it if you take a moment to share your thoughts—it helps us a ton!

👉 [url=https://forms.gle/TkjxNJTG93zs7Pjt8]Feedback Form[/url]
👉[url=https://forms.gle/rLTW6hNH7kvspG4W8] Bug Report Form[/url]

💬 Need immediate assistance? Join our official Discord [url=https://discord.gg/ignitionarena.]here[/url]

We will be in Discord ourselves during the stream! Feel free to come join us!

Thanks for your support, and we can’t wait to see you in the Arena! 🚀

notes.title: 🚀 Open Beta Update: New Launch Time! 🚀
notes.content:
Great news, everyone! After some thorough troubleshooting and testing, we’ve fixed the critical error and have our Steam build up and running.

We’ll need a little more time to finalize some additional fixes, so the Open Beta will now officially launch at [b]2 PM (MST) tomorrow[/b].

We’re sorry for this 1-day delay and truly appreciate your patience and support. We’re excited to see you all in the Arena tomorrow—thank you for being part of this journey! 🚀

notes.title: 🚨 Open Beta Start Delayed by 1 Hour 🚨
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re running a little behind schedule, so we’ll be pushing back the start of the Ignition Arena Open Beta by 1 hour. [b]The new launch time is now 3 PM (MST) today.[/b]

We’re putting the final touches in place and appreciate your patience as we ensure everything is ready to go!

If you have any questions or need further updates, we recommend joining our official Discord here: https://discord.gg/ignitionarena.

Thank you for your understanding, and we’ll see you in the Arena shortly! 🚀

notes.title: 🚨 One Week Until the Ignition Arena Open Beta! 🚨
notes.content:
The countdown is on! We’re just one week away from the start of the Ignition Arena Open Beta, and we’re so excited to welcome you all into the Arena.

🗓️ [b]Event Details:[/b]

[b]When:[/b] December 13th at 2 PM (MST) through December 15th
[b]Where:[/b] Right here on Steam!

Experience intense PvP battles, customize your ships, and explore the features of Ignition Arena!
Registration is open now, so sign up today!

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to see you in the Arena next week! 🚀
